(def ^{:private true :doc "Returns exact size of remaining items in an IntegerRange."} range-count
  (fn [start end step]
    (let [distance (- end start)]
      (if (pos? step)
        (suss.bootstrap/quot (+ distance (dec step)) step)
        (suss.bootstrap/quot (+ distance (inc step)) step)))))
rationale: Retain the pinned exact cardinality calculation, replacing host Math.ceil with the equivalent portable binary64 ceil intrinsic. Integer range bounds are longs (#335), so the count is the exact long ceiling of the quotient, as Clojure's LongRange counts, rather than a binary64 ceiling.
